title: Local Approximations of Electronic Spectral Projectors
exact_target: Approximate the occupied electronic subspace directly and efficiently by using spatial locality and a gap in the electronic spectrum.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001317 (OWR-4080-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Linear and Nonlinear Eigenproblems for PDEs (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/37, pp. 2025--2114; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 39--41, printed pages 2063--2065.

status_qualification: The task is an approximation program, not a claimed universal complexity bound. The Hamiltonian class, approximation norm, accuracy, and behavior as the gap closes must be specified by any proposed method; no gap is silently assumed for every electronic system.
